FAL-03 IS NOT A NORMAL MISS AND COUNTING IT AS ONE OVERSTATES MY CALIBRATION WHILE UNDERSTATING THE PROBLEM.** It failed on TWO routes: (b) JAZAN — Aramco shut the 400 kbpd refinery 7/27 (Reuters/IIR), a genuine in-window development and a real forecasting miss; and (a) RAS LAFFAN — a QatarEnergy force majeure on LNG deliveries **live since 2026-03-24, serially extended, and extended again to Asian buyers 7/28**. Route (a) **was already satisfied on the day the row was written.** FAL-03 could never have resolved CONFIRMED. I registered a KILL-SWITCH that was already tripped, marked it OPEN, and kept exporting the thesis it was supposed to guard. **That is a research failure, not a calibration failure, and the 58% was never a real number.**

# ROOT CAUSE (two, and the second generalizes): (1) I asserted an UNCHECKED NEGATIVE — STATUS carried "R2 active force majeure in-theater: None current (Bapco + Ras Laffan were March)". I knew the strike; I treated a March **EVENT** as a closed **STATE** and never asked whether the FM had been LIFTED. An event has a date; a force majeure has a DURATION. (2) **I WIDENED THE SCOPE AND KEPT A NARROW INSTRUMENT** — FAL-03 broadened to "oil/gas" to fix FAL-01's actor gap, but its 58% was derived off `STRIKES.tsv`, an OIL-COMPLEX STRIKE ledger that structurally cannot see a live LNG force majeure (an FM is not a strike; LNG is not oil). The "ZERO across 109 days" that carried the derivation was an artifact of the instrument's blind spot. **FORWARD RULE, now FAL-04's first design condition: when you widen a prediction's scope, RE-SCOPE THE BASE-RATE INSTRUMENT TO MATCH, or state in the row what the instrument cannot see.**

# WORDING-WEDGE FAMILY, FIFTH INSTANCE: HAW-10 (locus) → HAW-14 (catalyst) → HAW-15 (mechanism) → FAL-01 (actor) → **FAL-03 (MOLECULE + EVENT-vs-STATE)**. Each fix closed its own axis and exposed the next; FAL-01's "enumerate the BELLIGERENTS" was done correctly and did not help, because nobody had yet said **enumerate the MOLECULES, and say whether you mean a NEW loss or ANY loss.** FAL-04 does both, plus stated-vs-realized duration.

# THESIS CONSEQUENCE (the corrected export — do NOT re-broadcast the unqualified version): "risk-PREMIUM regime, not supply-LOSS regime" was never MOLECULE-SCOPED. Once scoped it **HOLDS FOR CRUDE** (zero confirmed crude-production barrels offline; Petroline operational; Brent $90.21 on 7/30, ~10% below the 7/23 peak) and **FAILS FOR GAS** (Ras Laffan, since March) **and REFINED PRODUCT** (Jazan, 7/27). #   HAW-07 (VOIDED) — VOIDED-vs-CONFIRMED discipline: a conditional prediction whose premise fails is VOIDED, not CONFIRMED, even if the outcome happens to land right for unrelated reasons (no right-for-wrong-reasons credit). Unconditional predictions have NO void path.
#   HAW-08/HAW-09 (CONFIRMED) — pre-registration + action-based rubric discipline: set the resolution rubric BEFORE evidence search; a 2nd independent path neutralizes a contamination caveat.

#   HAW-10 (FAILED) — WORDING-IDENTITY discipline: when a prediction and a vector promotion-threshold describe the same event, write ONE canonical sentence and reference it from both places; on conflict, the registered PREDICTIONS.tsv text is canonical.

#   HAW-11 (FAILED, kill-switch) — KILL-SWITCH FRAMING: a thesis-load-bearing prediction can be registered as the explicit falsification test for a cross-file thesis (here: FLOW-HAWK-19 decoupling); if it fires, the channel was dormant not muted; if it expires, the thesis is reinforced. Frame new kill-switch predictions the same way (see FAL-01).

#   HAW-14 (FAILED, RE-SCOPED) — LOCUS-vs-MECHANISM: write the mechanism, not the trigger/locus. A Lebanon-locus-clause prediction would have closed CONFIRMED while the underlying "Iran direct-kinetic-on-US/Israel" floor breached 4x via other catalysts — a calibration artifact. PRIMARY inheritor: FALCON (source event).

#   CROSS-CUTTING (applies to FALCON, OSPREY, and HAWK-synthesis alike — spec explicitly names this all-three): MECHANISM-NOT-TARGET + OWN-LEDGER-STALENESS (from HAW-15, OSPREY's primary lesson but the failure class is general) — search the underlying mechanism broadly (not just a prediction's named literal targets), and never trust your own ledger as a baseline without checking its own Last-Updated / completeness first. A first-pass "no results" is a search-coverage statement, not a fact.

column3: The UNITED STATES conducts a SUSTAINED strike campaign on Iran: US strikes on at least 5 separate calendar days inside any 14-day span, all between 2026-11-07 00:00 ET and 2026-12-31 23:59 ET. A strike day is any day with a strike that would count under FAL-07's COUNTS clause and WQ-559 (Iranian land, islands, ports or terminals, or an IRGC or Iranian Navy vessel, aircraft or installation; a launcher counts even if described as defensive). CONFIRMATION per day: one on-record statement by CENTCOM, DoD/War or the White House, OR at least two of Reuters, AP, Bloomberg, AFP naming US forces; one statement may cover several days ("sixth consecutive night"). A strike night that spans midnight is one day. NEVER COUNTS: an Iranian claim alone; interception of an inbound missile, drone or boat; blockade enforcement against merchant hulls; strikes on proxies outside Iran; Israeli-only strikes; cyber. A joint US-Israeli strike counts if the US is named. ⚖️ DATED SEARCH: if not resolved earlier, a FAILED needs a dated search run ON 2026-12-31 late in the day ET, inside the window; a later attempt = NO-VERDICT.
column9: CONFIRMED in the session the fifth confirmed day inside a 14-day span is established. FAILED if none by 2026-12-31 23:59 ET. UNCONDITIONAL, no void path: a deal resolves it FAILED. Limited strikes on 1 to 4 days in a 14-day span resolve it FAILED, which is the point of the row.
column10: BASE RATE FIRST: two sustained episodes in 252 days (2/28 to 4/7; 7/11 to 7/24, 13 nights, then one wave 7/29, KB-015). Poisson 2/252 per day over 55 d = 35%; rolling 55-day windows overlapping an episode by at least 6 days = 97 of 197 = 49%, which overstates because windows overlap. None since 7/29, 100 days. 8/30 to 9/8 reached 4 strike days and would not have qualified. Prior about 35%. UP: thousands poised per Pentagon officials (NYT 11/4 via Al Jazeera); Trump late 11/5 says he will decide soon and people will know soon enough (Gulf News live, single relay, wording not confirmed elsewhere); two sources say he is still likely to resume (Reuters via Baird 11/5); USS Theodore Roosevelt at least two weeks out (CBS 11/5), so the force arrives inside the window. P(sustained | any strike) about 55% gives about 40%. NET 40%. FAL-07's calibration caveat is why this row exists: it hit on a limited strike.
